resources.string: Plug the device into this phone\'s USB‑C port. The node page opens as soon as the USB link is up, even with mobile data or Wi‑Fi on.\n\nTo share mobile data with the node and its mesh, turn on Ethernet tethering: the page then opens over the tethering link.
The USB link is up, but the node does not answer yet. Retrying…
Chat messages and SOS from the mesh show up as notifications.
